# LunaJSON decoder

The boot environment uses the unmodified Lua decoder from LunaJSON 1.2.3 under the MIT license. Source revision `250afac121df831f449d6370ddf406673f6f9c2b` supplies both `src/lunajson/decoder.lua` and `LICENSE`. The decoder SHA-256 is `5257c567492e7c0203ae1a463313fce6b8d082db093a4aa841ccec8dec164546`. [Upstream source](https://github.com/grafi-tt/lunajson/tree/250afac121df831f449d6370ddf406673f6f9c2b)
